verdict.rationale: Runloop has credential-isolation features for agents. Agent Gateways let agents call LLM APIs like Anthropic and OpenAI without ever seeing the API keys, and MCP Hub gives agents MCP tool access without exposing credentials. Both are least-privilege patterns, but neither is issuing scoped API credentials as such, and account-level secrets are injected into devboxes as plain environment variables. Missing for 10: documented issuance of scoped or least-privilege Runloop API keys for agents, per-credential permission or resource scoping, expiry and revocation controls, and independent corroboration.
